WITH winner_hands AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing') AS throwing_hand
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
), hand_tallies AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM winner_hands
    GROUP BY throwing_hand
), hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand,
           tally,
           CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_tallies
), above_average AS (
    SELECT throwing_hand, tally, share
    FROM hand_shares
    WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM above_average;
